description: v1.3-only behavioural traits. Stable v1.2 roster loading ignores this file.

Gabriel Adib.basis: High-level two-way creator who scans for non-obvious runs and accepts difficult high-upside actions when the context supports them.

Mike Junior.basis: Strategic passer whose main differentiator is vision and option discovery rather than repeated high-variance execution.

Jorge Henrique.basis: Intelligent, versatile player with good reading but a comparatively controlled decision profile.

Remo.basis: Direct, powerful wide attacker: less focused on hidden-option creation, more willing to attack space and accept aggressive actions.
